summary.en: To the request of Ayumi, the Detective Boys visit a so-called haunted mansion on 4th Street. Armed with various objects to protect themselves and help themselves navigate the mansion, they break in from the back. They are scared by various things in the mansion, such as statues of gargoyles used as decoration and a door opened by the wind. Location: Mansion on 4-chōme Victim: Akio's father Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Unknown culprit The mansion's former owner was killed five years ago, leading people to claim it is haunted. The visit goes awry once the Detective Boys separate and start disappearing one by one. On his quest to locate them, Conan finds clues that indicate that this house may not be empty after all.
